grpan.2023.1.1.source_variant_note: Panhellenic university-entrance examinations of the day and evening General Lyceums, Thursday 8 June 2023, Πληροφορική Προσανατολισμού (Computer Science, orientation course); 4-page paper, four themes (Α–Δ), three hours. Marks (Μονάδες) are omitted, as are the cover lines and the closing instructions to candidates (ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ). Pseudocode is in ΓΛΩΣΣΑ and is kept in Greek in both versions. The figure is a binary tree: root 12; left child 7 with children Κ2 (whose left child is Κ3) and 10; right child Κ1 with children 17 (whose left child is Κ4) and 23 (whose right child is Κ5). The page headers of the 2023 paper are inconsistent (they read 3, 4, 3, 4 and end "ΤΕΛΟΣ 4ΗΣ ΑΠΟ 5 ΣΕΛΙΔΕΣ", while the cover says four pages); the page numbers here count the paper's pages in order.
